Samantha / team —
Attaching an updated MAP workbook (Ambrosia-MAP-v2.xlsx) and the Migration Runbook (Migration-Runbook.pdf). I embedded the post-signature implementation plan directly into the MAP in a tab called ‘Implementation Plan’. Highlights below:

Milestones (high level):
- 2027-10-01: Dedicated pool procurement confirmation (LAURA owner)
- 2027-10-15: Canary images + preflight tests complete (RISHI owner)
- 2027-10-18 — 2027-10-29: Internal validation & DRY-RUN for data migration (Ops + Ambrosia IT)
- 2027-11-01 — 2027-11-07: Pilot (50 users) + clinician training during pilot prep week
- 2027-11-15 — 2027-11-29: Canary tranches (3 tranches over 2 weeks)
- 2027-12-06: Broad rollout target (subject to quality gates)

Rollback & quality gates: included in the runbook — default rollback triggers: latency > 2x baseline for 10+ minutes, P99 errors > 1%, or model-quality drop > 5% against baseline eval set. We recommend a 2-hour rapid rollback process and a 24-hour stabilization hold after any rollback.

Training schedule (proposed):
- Ops workshop: 2027-10-25 10:00–11:30 PT (live, hands-on)
- Clinician overview: 2027-10-28 14:00–15:30 PT (live)
- Recorded clinician session available by 2027-10-21

Related items: DocuSign link for SOW has been shared with procurement (see related links). Please review the MAP workbook and runbook and flag any missing dependencies.

Attachments: Ambrosia-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet); Migration-Runbook.pdf (pdf)
